name: birthday-bot
description: A WhatsApp bot that tracks birthdays and sends automatic birthday messages

scripts.clean-start: bun run clean && bun run start
scripts.logs: bun --eval "const {Database}=require('bun:sqlite');const db=new Database('bot.db');db.query('SELECT * FROM logs ORDER BY id').all().forEach(r=>console.log(`[${r.timestamp}] [${r.level}] ${r.message}`))"
